description: $0.02 USDC on Solana per payload - the payment buys one signed pre-flight lint of the one unsigned SVM payload you submit in descriptor form: instruction-shape, compute-budget and fee-payer checks against the published policy table (incl. the PayAI boundary), every finding named. The payload is never signed and never stored.

artefact.description: The one unsigned payload artefact in the published submission form for the op (EVM: the EIP-712 descriptor form; SVM: the instruction-descriptor form). Processed in memory only, never stored, never signed.

name: payload_preflight_svm
